$comment: Quality gates for the qa, spec-build and spec-check skills (node .agents/skills/qa/scripts/gates.mjs fast|full) and the Claude Code hooks. `full` mirrors CI; `fast` runs in the Stop hook, filtered by `paths` (prefixes of changed repository paths). `needs` lists the ids a gate waits for; gates without needs between them run in parallel. Optional per gate: `fix` (auto-fix command), `note` (guidance when it is red).

full.name: agent skills in sync
full.note: Vendored skills are edited in amigo-labs/skills and synced with `node .agents/sync.mjs`; a repository's own skills are edited in .agents/skills, then `node .agents/sync.mjs --mirror`.
